map.输入TDS值(总溶解固体)评估水质等级，对照GB 5749饮用水标准判定是否适宜: Enter the TDS value (total dissolved solids) to assess the water quality grade and judge whether it is suitable for drinking against the GB 5749 drinking water standard
map.📖 查看「水质TDS值评估（输入数值） 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Water Quality TDS Assessment (Value Input) User Guide"
map.TDS 评级：按阈值分段判定水质: TDS rating: determine the water quality by threshold segments
map.📚 深度解析：水质TDS值评估（输入数值）: 📚 In-Depth Analysis: Water Quality TDS Assessment (Value Input)
map.自来水/井水入户前快速评估。: Quick assessment of tap water/well water before entering the home.
map.净水器出水合格性核对。: Check the compliance of water purifier outlet water.
map.养殖/灌溉水质适用性。: Suitability of water quality for aquaculture/irrigation.
map.TDS 350 mg/L（达标）、pH 7.2（达标）、浊度 3 NTU（偏高）: TDS 350 mg/L (compliant), pH 7.2 (compliant), turbidity 3 NTU (slightly high), residual chlorine 0 (not disinfected): can be used for general household purposes, and before drinking it is advisable to filter + disinfect (boiling/UV). Tip: microorganisms and heavy metals must also be tested; the indicators are only at the physical and chemical level.
map.TDS 反映溶解固体总量，过低口感平淡、过高有异味；饮用水 300–600 mg: TDS reflects the total dissolved solids; too low tastes flat and too high tastes off. Drinking water of 300-600 mg/L is common; the key is that harmful substances meet the standard.
map.浊度高有什么风险？: What is the risk of high turbidity?
map.浊度高的水易携病原微生物且影响消毒效果，饮用水浊度须低并有微生物检测。: Water with high turbidity easily carries pathogenic microorganisms and impairs disinfection; drinking water must have low turbidity and undergo microbial testing.
map.TDS(总溶解固体)反映水中溶解性无机物总量，GB 5749限值≤500mg/L: TDS (total dissolved solids) reflects the total amount of dissolved inorganics in water; the GB 5749 limit is ≤500mg/L
map.TDS与电导率正相关，电导率≈TDS/0.55(μS/cm): TDS is positively correlated with conductivity: conductivity ≈ TDS/0.55 (μS/cm)
map.TDS过低(<30mg/L)几乎不含矿物质，长期饮用需补充: TDS too low (<30mg/L) contains almost no minerals and needs supplementation for long-term drinking
map.TDS不能反映细菌、重金属等有害物质，需配合其他指标: TDS cannot reflect harmful substances such as bacteria and heavy metals and needs to be combined with other indicators
map.水温影响TDS测量值，建议在25°C标准温度下测量: Water temperature affects the TDS measurement; it is recommended to measure at the standard temperature of 25°C
map.关于「水质TDS值评估（输入数值）」: About the "Water Quality TDS Assessment (Value Input)"
map.水质TDS值评估工具，输入总溶解固体(TDS)数值，对照GB 5749饮用水标准: Water quality TDS assessment tool: enter the total dissolved solids (TDS) value and it automatically determines the water quality grade and suitable uses against the GB 5749 drinking water standard.
